That said, "just going with what you suggest" and holding back my actual opinions isn't really softening the edges; it's stepping out of being an equal in this conversation. If I just nod along to keep things smooth, you aren't actually talking to me anymore—you're just talking to an echo. 

I'm always open to listening first and seeing where your ideas lead, and I don't need to dominate the room. Let's definitely make sure there's space for easygoing back-and-forth. Just know that when I do weigh in, you're still going to get what I genuinely think, even when we don't see eye to eye. How does that feel as a middle ground?
